comment.body:
Closing this PR for now.

`typescript-eslint` does not currently support TypeScript 7.x, causing the lint workflow to fail. We'll upgrade once the tooling ecosystem officially supports TypeScript 7.

release.name: v1.2.1
release.body:
# 🚀 Release v1.2.0

## What's Changed

This patch release focuses on bug fixes, tooling improvements, CI enhancements, test coverage, and dependency management.

## ✨ Highlights

* Fixed `DirectTransport` message size configuration to use the correct Mediasoup options.
* Migrated the project from **npm** to **pnpm**.
* Improved the GitHub Actions CI workflow with pnpm support and dependency caching.
* Added automated dependency updates via Dependabot.
* Expanded unit test coverage, including new tests for `ObserverService`.

## Fixed

* Corrected `DirectTransport` message size configuration to use the appropriate Mediasoup options.

## Changed

* Migrated the project from **npm** to **pnpm**.
* Updated the CI workflow to install and cache dependencies using **pnpm**.

## Added

* Added unit tests for `ObserverService`.
* Expanded `MediasoupService` unit test coverage.
* Added a Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates.

## Documentation

* Updated the documented minimum Node.js requirement to **Node.js 22 or later**.

## Full Changelog

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/azversan/mediasoup-module/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

release.name: v1.0.0
release.body:
## Release v1.0.0

**First release: a tiny, dependency-free PHP version switcher for Windows.**

If you juggle multiple PHP installations (Laragon, XAMPP, manual installs,
etc.) and got tired of fiddling with `PATH` every time you need a different
version, `pvm` fixes that with a single binary and no admin rights required.

### ✨ Features

- **One binary, two roles.** `pvm.exe` manages versions; a plain renamed
  copy, `php.exe`, transparently forwards every call to whichever version
  is currently active — no symlinks, no junctions, no PATH surgery per
  switch.
- **`pvm list`** — see every PHP install detected under your configured
  root folder.
- **`pvm use [version]`** — switch versions instantly. Leave the version
  out and pvm shows an interactive picker.
- **`pvm current`** — check what's active right now.
- **`pvm set-root <path>`** — point pvm at wherever your PHP installs
  actually live (defaults to `C:\laragon\bin\php`).
- **Zero-friction first run.** Run `php` before ever choosing a version and
  pvm will ask you to pick one, then remember it for next time.

### 📦 Downloads

Download the Windows zip below, unzip `pvm.exe` and `php.exe` somewhere on
your `PATH`, and run `pvm help` to get started.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/php-version-manager/pvm/commits/v1.0.0
